_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone2" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "search_text" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "addresses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "label" TEXT NULL, "district" TEXT NULL, "neighborhood" TEXT NULL, "address_line" TEXT NOT NULL, "floor" TEXT NULL, "apartment_no" TEXT NULL, "directions" TEXT NULL, "search_text" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "devices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "address_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES addresses (id), "brand" TEXT NOT NULL, "model" TEXT NULL, "serial_no" TEXT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "install_year" INTEGER NULL, "warranty_end" TEXT NULL, "maintenance_interval_months" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 12, "next_maintenance_date" TEXT NULL, "last_reminder_sent_at" INTEGER NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "search_text" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "appointments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "device_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES devices (id), "scheduled_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "service_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES devices (id), "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_periodic_maintenance" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_periodic_maintenance" IN (0, 1)), "complaint" TEXT NULL, "error_code" TEXT NULL, "work_notes" TEXT NULL, "checklist_items" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "water_pressure_bar" REAL NULL, "expansion_tank_bar" REAL NULL, "flue_co_ppm" INTEGER NULL, "labor_fee" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "appointment_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES appointments (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "service_parts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "service_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES service_records (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "unit_price" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "service_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES service_records (id), "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "photos" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "owner_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "thumb_file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "checklist_templates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE INDEX idx_services_device_date ON service_records (device_id, date)
CREATE INDEX idx_photos_owner ON photos (owner_type, owner_id)
